steps.step: Funder creates a pot, signed with ML-DSA-87 and checked by pqcVerify
steps.detail: pot #2, vault 0xccF2aeb474fbc953Df1509664d94Ec562d600CA7, one approved payee (up to 60 fUSD)

steps.step: The pot's short link code (the first 8 bytes of its vault) finds it
Funder pays 100 fUSD into the pot's address from the bank lane (MsgConvertCoin, hybrid-signed)
The person spending the pot pays the approved shop 25 fUSD, post-quantum signed
steps.detail: shop received 25 fUSD; the spender sent no transaction and paid no gas

steps.step: Independent check of that payment: statement and key read from the chain at the block before, ML-DSA-87 verified off chain
steps.detail: signature valid: true; the same signature over "Amount: 26": false

steps.step: The shop confirms the address is its own, with its own ML-DSA-87 key
The spender asks the funder to approve a new shop, for 15 fUSD
steps.detail: request recorded with its amount; the pot still can't pay it

steps.step: The funder approves it up to 12 fUSD, an amount of its own choice, post-quantum signed
steps.detail: Brightline Electrical approved, up to 12 fUSD in total

steps.step: The spender pays the new shop 10 fUSD
steps.detail: a shop with no post-quantum key of its own can still be paid

steps.step: Rule: a payment past what the funder approved for that shop is refused, even properly signed
steps.detail: refused: OverPayeeLimit (2 fUSD left for this shop)

steps.step: Attack: open an EVM window with the funder's stolen classical key only
steps.detail: refused by the chain: account qor1fjvghvanvsg3r95kc5vyzu9gvat6970fv30w26 has a registered PQC key and must include the hybrid signature extension (hybrid mode: required): hybrid PQC signature required

steps.step: Attack: inside an open window, send addPayee from the funder's own address without its post-quantum signature
steps.detail: reverted on chain (BadPqcSignature): the attacker was not added

steps.step: Attack: the funder's statement signed with the attacker's own registered ML-DSA-87 key
Replay to the relayer: it returns the first payment and sends nothing new
Attack: replay the spender's signed payment straight to the chain
Attack: a properly signed payment to an address the funder never approved
Attack: raise the amount to 20 fUSD after the spender signed 1 fUSD
Rule: a payment over the 30 fUSD cap is refused, even properly signed
Rule: payments count towards the 60 fUSD weekly limit
Rule: a payment past the weekly limit is refused
steps.detail: refused: OverPeriodLimit (5 fUSD left this week)

steps.step: The funder freezes the pot (the lost-phone button), post-quantum signed
A properly signed payment from a frozen pot is refused
After the end date, the rest goes back to the funder (anyone may trigger it)
